title: Photo Spec Check
summary: Checks an exam, passport or visa photo against the portal's rules before upload and fixes size, crop and file weight in the browser.
description: Photo upload check against portal presets (UPSC, SSC, NTA, NEET, US visa) or your spec: real file type, KB, pixels, shape, print size, over-compression, face size and centring, background and colour, with a canvas fix that crops, resizes and re-encodes.
catches: File type that doesn't match its name
File size outside the KB window, and over-compression
Pixel size, aspect ratio or print size out of spec
Face too small or off-centre, when you pass a face box
Background that isn't white, or a black-and-white photo
limits: Presets reflect the sources below and change often; portals may also check things this can't (glasses, expression)
Face checks need a face box from your detector
The canvas fix re-encodes the photo
a11y: Choose button is described by the spec; the hidden file input is removed from tab order
Status lines have text; icons are aria-hidden
Focus moves to the fix or choose button after reading

sources.label: UPSC: photo and signature upload instructions

rules.note: Informational; check the official source. Confirmed: US visa JPEG, square 600–1200 px, ≤ 240 kB, compression ≤ 20:1; UPSC colour JPG named photo, 20–200 KB. SSC, NTA and NEET presets were not re-checked this round.

stops: Helps prevent an exam photo being rejected after upload
